en: Colorized historical postcard view of a large circular public square with gardens and walkways, centered on a prominent statue standing on a white pedestal. Trees and flowerbeds surround the monument, with cyclists, pedestrians, and a tram visible in the background. The scene is bordered by elegant late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century buildings and lots of greenery. The caption at the bottom in red type identifies the location as Keizer Karelplein in Nijmegen.
